entities.name: Anim Pakal
entities.description: A human Oltec general of the Thousand Moons on Ixalan, known as the Thousandth Moon, and sister of Akal Pakal.

entities.name: Matzalantli
entities.description: The site of the seal opened in 5 Dawn Era.

entities.name: Thousand Moons
entities.description: The Oltec force that Anim Pakal is general of.

events.summary: When the seal at Matzalantli is opened in 5 Dawn Era, Pakal is among the first to meet the explorers.
events.quote: Pakal was among the first to meet the explorers

relations.note: Anim Pakal is the sister of Akal Pakal.
